visual_goal: Show the close platform receiving copies of balances and transactions from many sources, writing back only approved journals, sending consolidation a status signal and keeping the evidence.
prompt: A left-to-right diagram. At the far left, three source groups stacked vertically: three open ledger books side by side labeled once 'Ledgers'; below them a plain office building labeled 'Payment providers'; below that a bank building labeled 'Banks'. From each source group one arrow carrying a small stack of photocopied pages runs right into a wide funnel labeled 'Ingestion'. One arrow from the funnel into a large central platform box labeled 'BlackLine', drawn with four small inner tiles showing a check mark, a pair of linked squares, a clipboard and a pen. From the platform, three outputs: one curved arrow running back left along the top into the 'Ledgers' books, labeled 'approved journals'; one arrow right to a box labeled 'OneStream', where the arrow carries only a small green flag labeled 'certified'; and one arrow down to a locked folder labeled 'Evidence archive'. Exactly seven arrows.
alt: Ledgers, payment providers and banks send copies through an ingestion funnel into BlackLine, which sends approved journals back to the ledgers, only a certified flag to OneStream, and its evidence to a locked archive.

visual_goal: Show the three matching legs for one Lisbon booking, each with its own key: expected receipt to Adyen line by booking id, line to batch by batch number, batch to bank by payout reference, with the fee split off by rule.
prompt: A left-to-right chain of four stations connected by three arrows, each of these three arrows carrying a small key icon with its own short label. At the far left, a document labeled 'Expected receipt' with the amount '600.00'. One arrow with a blue key labeled 'booking id' into a single report line strip labeled 'Adyen line'. From 'Adyen line' one arrow with a green key labeled 'batch number' into a bundle of several report line strips tied together labeled 'Batch 1047'. From the bundle one arrow with an orange key labeled 'payout reference' into a bank building at the far right labeled 'Bank credit' with the amount '1,380.52'. Below 'Adyen line', a small pair of scissors cuts off a small coin that drops into a tray labeled 'Fee'. Only three keys in the whole picture, one on each of the three main arrows.
alt: A chain from the 600.00 expected receipt to the Adyen line on the booking id key, from the line to batch 1047 on the batch number key, and from the batch to the 1,380.52 bank credit on the payout reference key, with the fee split off below the Adyen line.

visual_goal: Show one settlement day's files arriving with control totals checked at the gate before matching, exceptions returning to the team that owns the keys, and the clearing reconciliation supported by the matching result.
prompt: A left-to-right diagram with three horizontal rows on the left and one large panel on the right. Top row: at the far left a plain office box labeled 'Adyen', with one arrow carrying a document right into a box labeled 'Northmere Pay' that shows a small funnel. Middle row: a box labeled 'SFP' directly below 'Northmere Pay'. Bottom row: a bank building labeled 'Kyriba' directly below 'SFP'. 'Adyen' connects only to 'Northmere Pay'. Each of 'Northmere Pay', 'SFP' and 'Kyriba' sends one arrow carrying a file document with a small calculator tag to a checkpoint gate with a green check mark labeled 'control totals'. The gate is the entrance of a large panel on the right labeled 'BlackLine'. Inside the panel, one arrow from the gate into a box with two interlocking puzzle pieces labeled 'Matching', and one arrow from 'Matching' into a box with an open book and a check mark labeled 'Clearing reconciliation'. One red curved arrow starts at the top edge of the 'Matching' box, rises above the panel and runs back left into the top of 'Northmere Pay'; it is labeled 'exceptions'. Exactly seven arrows.
alt: Adyen's report goes to Northmere Pay for normalization; Northmere Pay, SFP and Kyriba send files whose control totals are checked at BlackLine's gate before matching, which supports the clearing reconciliation and sends exceptions back to Northmere Pay.

visual_goal: Show the four close days removed in three groups: one day by BlackLine configuration alone, two days needing BlackLine and upstream data together, and one day needing no close-platform change.
prompt: A left-to-right diagram. At the far left, a tall calendar block labeled '9-day close'. At the far right, a shorter calendar block labeled '5-day close'. Between them, three parallel horizontal lanes, each starting with one arrow from the left block and ending with one arrow into the right block. Upper lane, blue: a lane labeled 'BlackLine only' carrying one small calendar tile and the label '1 day'. Middle lane, half blue and half green: a lane labeled 'BlackLine plus upstream' carrying two small calendar tiles and the label '2 days'. Lower lane, green: a lane labeled 'Upstream only' carrying one small calendar tile and the label '1 day'. The calendar tiles carry no writing. Exactly six arrows.
alt: From a 9-day close to a 5-day close along three lanes: BlackLine only removes one day, BlackLine plus upstream data removes two days, and upstream changes alone remove one day.
